note.description: Optional note from the curator about why they added this item.

images.description: Post subjects only: the 0-based positions of the post's photos this item keeps, for someone filing only some photos of a multi-photo post. Absent means every photo. A selection naming none of the post's photos is treated as absent.

subject.description: Strong-ref to the post or article being collected. Subject can be any AT-URI; the AppView resolves what to render based on the URI's collection (app.bsky.feed.post or app.zeens.article).

collection.description: AT-URI of the parent app.zeens.collection record.

submission.description: Community collections only: the photographer's own collectionItem this item approves. While it is set, the item is shown only as long as that submission exists, so deleting the submission withdraws the photo.

main.description: A single item (post or article) inside a Zeens collection. The collection itself is referenced by its AT-URI. Removing an item is a record delete. Re-adding the same subject creates a new item record (clients should de-dupe by subject.uri at write time if needed).
